reason: The plan draws only the phase IV mud-brick rooms of Block B, about 18 m by 11 m, with walls 1 m wide (2 px in the imagery). No exposed wall pattern in the Acropolis or the Lower Town excavation matches the nested rooms, the fire altar or the oblique long wall in any quarter-turn orientation, and no plan in the available publications locates Block B against features that survive.
